policy: Every long-tail method reviewed by swarmstr-u6gn.8 is pinned as implemented, intentionally divergent, or deferred to a dedicated bead. Methods in the latter two states must not be advertised by Metiq.

implemented.semantics: Preferences are caller-scoped to the authenticated Nostr pubkey, use bounded PATCH semantics, and persist in the versioned user-profile ledger. Role metadata is durable, nullable, and restricted to configured gateway.roles definitions.

CRUD is backed only by a ProtectedSecretBackend and produces structured store SecretRefs. Secret-kind values are never listed; env-kind values follow the upstream list contract. All three methods are authenticated WebSocket/internal-only and non-replayable so values cannot enter Nostr events or durable response caches.

Goals and bounded 24-hour idempotency receipts persist atomically in the durable session document. Session and goal identities fence lifecycle changes; conflicting operation reuse is rejected; resume dispatches the real agent/steering path exactly once. Because Metiq has no separate chat goal-start RPC, the first edit transition explicitly creates the goal.

All four provider token counters are persisted on each terminal transcript turn. Summary, bounded timeseries, and log projections read only that durable history, with UTC date/range filters and no fabricated model, context-weight, or cost data.

Gateway proposal mutations append sequence-ordered lifecycle events to an atomic workspace ledger. Manual evaluation is revision-fenced and projects the existing immutable proposal static scan into a completed metiq.core evaluator outcome; no external plugin evaluator result is fabricated.

The response resolves the selected agent workspace, scans only that workspace's hooks against the live manager's enable overrides, retains daemon-loaded bundled/managed hooks, and merges registration facts from the active unified plugin registry. The read path never registers or executes a hook.

Gateway run identity is propagated into tool execution and persisted as run_id/execution_id on permission-audit records. Inspection returns bounded correlated decision displays with safe-only fields; legacy receipt provenance and the richer principal/lineage identity context are explicitly unknown rather than fabricated.

intentional_divergences.rationale: Metiq has no command-lane scheduler, capacity groups, or queued/active lane accounting. Agent jobs, session mailboxes, and prompt-assembly lanes are different state and must not be projected as OpenClaw command-lane diagnostics.
Metiq has no browser-push service, VAPID key lifecycle, or push subscription store; notifications flow through Nostr/channel events.
Metiq does not own GitHub OAuth, hosted project search, or a GitHub publication lifecycle; repositories and worktrees are operator-managed.
Metiq is a daemon and has no OpenClaw desktop worker host/process model.
There is no portal process/window lifecycle in Metiq.
Metiq exposes durable tasks and lifecycle gateway events instead of an OpenClaw progress-card projection.
These bind to OpenClaw's Control UI and GitHub preview model; Metiq has its own Web UI, board, artifact, and worktree surfaces.
Metiq authenticates with Nostr identities/device pairing and invokes its internal hook manager directly; it has no web-login or native-hook relay RPC.
WebSocket connection establishment is a transport handshake, not an RPC. chat.inject bypasses authenticated Nostr/session ingress and violates Metiq's event-driven routing contract.
Opening a host editor is a UI/OS side effect; Metiq already exposes config get/set/apply/patch/schema surfaces.
